assessment: Names normalised and unique matches stated, but exact normalisation dictionary and boundary-state limitation are not fully reported.
Unmatched and ambiguous records are excluded and retained in audit materials.
Repeated-name exclusion is stated, but duplicate detection fields and counts are not fully tabulated in the manuscript.
Dataset and event totals are stated; spatial-intersection fallback after metadata filtering is not fully described.
Flooded pixels equal to one and JRC permanent-water pixels excluded.
Area normalisation is defined, but the exact geometry-area computation and projection settings are absent.
Main formulas are stated, but zero-history handling and event deduplication are incomplete.
Fatality missingness is clear; handling of missing duration/injury fields in all benchmarks is not exhaustively documented.
Explosion is stated, but LGD/name precedence and mismatched district/code list handling are absent.
Conservative unique assignment and interpretation of zeros are explicit.
Development-only standardisation is stated, but population standard deviation and zero-variance handling are absent.
L2 and deterministic optimisation are stated; L-BFGS-B, mean-loss scaling, clipping and intercept treatment are absent.
Alpha=1 is given, but the exact 0.5*alpha penalty and unpenalised intercept are absent.
State blocking is clear; state ordering, balancing algorithm and fold membership are in outputs rather than Methods.
Simplex constraints and near-tie rule are stated; the 0.025 grid increment is absent.
Results are reported, but the subtract-within-state-means formula is not described in Methods.
Seed, samples and percentile intervals are reported; duplicate block identifiers and fixed-k tie handling within resamples are absent.
Fixed group size and state/district tie-breaking are stated.
